segments.dry: One reviewer with dry-leaning skin that normally breaks out when a product doesn't suit her reports no irritation or scent with this product, saying it hydrates evenly without drying her skin out.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry skin and an oily T-zone reports the pads give her skin a nice glow and sit well under makeup as part of her morning routine.
segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are largely positive, with several — including some who also have acne, rosacea, or allergies — saying the pads caused no irritation and calmed their skin; however, one reviewer with sensitive skin reports the pads caused a bad breakout, attributing it to too much essential oil in the formula.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the pads as hydrating without feeling greasy, heavy, or sticky, leaving skin feeling plump, soft, and evenly moisturized rather than dried out.
concerns.redness: Reviewers frequently report the pads calm redness and soothe irritated skin, including redness from sources like waxing and general sensitivity, with several describing visibly calmer, brighter-looking skin after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the pads as leaving skin feeling soft with a strong, clean-feeling barrier and no irritation, though another cautions against daily use, viewing the pads as mildly exfoliating and a possible over-exfoliation risk for sensitive skin with frequent use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with a history of hyperpigmentation reports the pads have helped reduce associated redness, though she does not specify whether the dark spots themselves faded.
concerns.blemishes: Reports on breakouts are mixed: one reviewer says the formula's essential oil content caused a bad breakout with large pimples after a few days of use, while others — including one who says she normally breaks out from unsuitable products — report no new breakouts or irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the pads' finish as non-greasy and lightweight, not adding shine or heaviness, including one who uses them despite having an oily T-zone without issue.

aspects.libelle: Pads split in two for double use

extraits.texte: I thought it was working great until it started breaking me out a few days after. The photo I’m sharing is after I stopped using a few days so the acne is a little bit better. But I’ve gotten huge pimples. I was hoping that it would work, but it’s just too much essential oil for me.

The product is fine but in my opinion toners are not worth the price. I have sensitive skin and it flares up easily, but I can’t say if this makes any difference, at least not obvious. Another thing is that if you’re already using a moisturizer adding a toner doesn’t do much, at least for me I can’t see the point of it. I like that it feels like using a face mask but that’s mainly it. If you want to save money I don’t think you need this, sometimes I forget it in my desk.

I really like the hydration this product gives to my skin. It doesn’t feel greasy or heavy, and it has never caused any irritation or bad reactions, even though I have sensitive skin with acne, rosacea, and allergies. I do like this product, but I personally wouldn’t recommend it for daily use because over-exfoliating the skin with these types of products is not always the best idea, especially for sensitive skin.

I’m a makeup and skincare junkie and this is one of the only toner pads I have ever repurchased. I love using this in the morning before my AM skincare and makeup routine. It sits well under makeup and adds a nice glow to my skin. For reference, I have dry skin with an oily tzone.

extraits.titre: Another Korean skincare win! So soothing after a microneedling session and great for sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: I love these water pads. I first saw them at an Olive Young store in Seoul, South Korea on my most recent visit there and I wanted to purchase them then, but my luggage was already at full capacity with all of the other Korean skincare and cosmetic goodies I'd purchased, so I was thrilled to see them being sold on Amazon. I have sensitive skin and these have been dermatologically tested and deemed safe for sensitive skin and I concur because they have caused me no irritation, but they do have a scent and I think it's just lovely. The appeal (or disgust) of a scent is highly individualized, but I personally love this one and more than carrot, I smell the sage notes and just a bit of lavender. Sometimes, I don't want to wear a full mask of product or I just have a couple of areas that need a little extra attention and care and these fit the bill. They are thick and can be split in two, so a jar of 60 is more like 120 and they actually adhere better when split. Keep in mind they're not precut to be split, so sometimes you'll see more pad on one side than the other, but it doesn't affect the end result. I'd absolutely buy these again.

extraits.titre: 思った以上に良かった
extraits.texte: 気に入ったのでリピート 乾燥肌気味で合わないと吹き出物が出るタイプですが、刺激も匂いもなく使いやすいです さっぱりめですがすぐ乾燥することもなく、フラットに潤います 化粧水を手早く塗布したく使ってみましたが、とても便利で自分には合っていました 通常の化粧水は面倒に感じていましたが、こちらはパッドで軽く顔全体に馴染ませたあと半分に割いて頬にペッと乗せて、その間に服を着ればパックしている状態になるので楽ちんです パックがしっかりしているので割きやすいですし、コットンが変に伸びたりしません パッドのものは肌への摩擦が懸念でしたが、1枚1枚がすごく化粧水たっぷりなので肌への負担が気にならず、パックしたあともカスカスになっていないです 今1つ目がほぼ使い終わるところですが、最後まで化粧水しみしみです 肌の調子が上がる等のすごい効果はとくに感じませんが、しっかりケアがしやすいので結果スキンケアがちゃんと出来てめんどくさがりな自分には良い商品です

extraits.titre: Feels super soothing on your skin!
extraits.texte: This is my favorite product in my skincare routine. I've struggled with hyperpigmentation for years, and I feel like this product has helped reduce a lot of my redness. I put one pad on each of my cheeks for ~10 minutes every night after I've cleansed and dried my face, and it feels so cooling on my skin. It's like a mini face mask that I use everyday.
